title: Strategies to improve the photovoltaic performance of M-series acceptor-based polymer solar cells: chemical hybridization versus physical blending of acceptors
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,2895-2904
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE00294J, Paper
Haiting Shi, Hui Guo, Dongdong Cai, Jin-Yun Wang, Yunlong Ma, Qingdong Zheng
A novel asymmetric M-series acceptor (M36-FCl) with a large dielectric constant and a smaller exciton dissociation barrier has been developed for high-performance polymer solar cells.
